Sam (Growth): Pushing a webinar idea: 'Observability for Inference: How to measure what really matters' 1 practical dashboards, 1 live demo of tracing + 1 short customer ops story. Want a tight run-of-show and clear lead routing.
Ethan (DevEx): good one. I can demo trace->span correlation for a token stream and show tracing latency buckets. live demo ~9m.
Lina (Speaker Ops): let's lock speakers by EOD Monday. we need a main, a backup, and someone to run the live controls. Also two rehearsals: tech check + full dress.
Priya (Cust Mktg): will prepare the customer ops story (5m) showing before/after alerting and cost regression rollback. can source metrics + a 15s clip.
Noah (Sales): recommend we add a CTA that lets enterprise attendees request a "health check" trial. route to AE when tokens >1M/month.
Sam (Growth): draft run-of-show: 1) Intro + goals (Sam) 3m 2) Why observability matters (Priya) 6m 3) Product overview + SLOs (Raj?) 7m 4) Live demo (Ethan) 9m 5) Customer ops story (Priya) 5m 6) Quick checklist: what to instrument 5m 7) Q&A + office hours sign-up 18m 8) CTA & wrap 2m. leaves 5m buffer. thoughts?
Ethan (DevEx): prefer sliding 2x live->recorded: do a recorded fallback of the trace demo in case live infra hiccups. I'll also include a small CLI snippet: `redwood trace start --demo --ephemeral-key` to paste into run-of-show.
Lina (Speaker Ops): rehearsal windows Thu 16:00 UTC (tech, 30m) and Mon 09:30 UTC (full run, 55m). please RSVP and upload slides 24h prior. greenroom-bot will create calendar events.
greenroom-bot: rehearsal invites generated. respond with ACK to confirm. timezone conversion included.
Priya (Cust Mktg): mapping for lead routing: health_check_optin -> CRM.case_type, tokens_estimate -> CRM.tokens, enterprise_flag -> AE.queue. I'll post the mapping doc in #marketing-assets.
Noah (Sales): will draft the AE outreach email (subject + 3 bullets) and landing page CTA copy. include calendar booking link.
Sam (Growth): telemetry ask: instrument p95, p99, median, cost/1k tokens and a simple funnel metric: demo->trial->AE meeting. Ethan, can you add a short dashboard screenshot for the landing page?
Ethan (DevEx): yes — I'll export a static PNG of the dashboard and attach to #marketing-assets. also adding the recorded fallback video.
Lina (Speaker Ops): everyone ACK rehearsals and upload slides 24h before. need confirmations by EOD tomorrow so I can confirm greenroom schedule.
Ethan (DevEx): ACK Thu + Mon. will upload assets.
Priya (Cust Mktg): ACK both. uploading customer clip Wed EOD.
Noah (Sales): ACK both. drafting outreach now.
Sam (Growth): perfect. Lina 1 ping greenroom-bot to send rehearsal reminders at 48h and 1h. I'll finalize landing page copy today and share for review. :sparkles:
